Definition: from G2596 and G3739; according to which thing, i.e. precisely as, in proportion as:--according to that, (inasmuch) as.
BiblicalUsage: Katho means according as, precisely as, the word that measures one thing against another. Romans 8:26 uses it when Paul says we know not what we should pray for as we ought, and 1 Peter 4:13 uses it when Peter says to rejoice inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word as matters most when it joins our weakness to Christ's sufferings and our prayers to the Spirit's help.
